title: Daily billed revenue
description: Paid invoices and billed revenue (USD) per day, for every region or the one picked. Reads daily_revenue.

args.sql:
SELECT day, SUM(invoices) AS invoices, ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS revenue
FROM daily_revenue
WHERE (CAST({{region}} AS TEXT) IS NULL OR region = CAST({{region}} AS TEXT))
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day
